items.title: 'We hacked the FBI:' Hackers say they have data on all FBI employees
‘We Hacked the FBI:’ Hackers Say They Have Data on All FBI Employees

brief: 'We hacked the FBI:' Hackers say they have data on all FBI employees is the one topic Wednesday, September 23's feeds agree on — it surfaced on hackernews, lemmy at the same minute. Builders spent the day on anthropics/financial-services. On Steam, Counter-Strike 2 drew the biggest crowd.
